# Step 1 of the Q-040 sequence: the two USD invoices, posted.
#
# Two USD invoices posted to one receivable, neither collected. Anonymised from
# a real book: the account numbers, the payment provider and the customer are
# invented, while the dates, the amounts and the rates are the ones the book
# held.
